Paid acquisition: connect ad accounts, see campaigns and reports, and find what needs attention.
Voidhash reads ads; it never changes them.

Usage:
  voidhash ads <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  ads, ad

Commands:
  accounts     List the connected ad accounts and how their syncs are doing.
  connect      Connect a Meta ad account with a system user token.
  disconnect   Disconnect an ad account and delete what was synced from it.
  campaigns    List the campaigns synced from your ad accounts, or show one.
  report       Ads reports: performance, creatives and cohorts.
  issues       What needs attention in your ads.
  settings     The project's ads settings.
  measurement  What Voidhash tells Meta: the Conversions API and the install referrer key.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash ads <command> --help' for more about a command.
